name: fiefdom
description: An isometric castle-builder in the spirit of Stronghold Crusader, played in the browser. Build a settlement in the desert, run the food, ale and weapon chains, raise a garrison and hold your ground against an enemy lord who builds his own economy under the same rules you do. ⚔ Multiplayer: two to four players on one map, allied or every lord for himself, with AI lords to fill the empty seats. Players register on your server with a name, an email and a password — nothing to configure, no mail server, no external login. ⚙ Nothing to set up: no database, no API keys. Set the port, keep the Saves path on appdata, start it, open the WebUI. 💾 Saved games, custom maps and accounts are stored on the server under /data — map it to appdata and they survive updates and are the same in every browser. (Leave it unmapped and the game falls back to per-browser storage and nobody can register.) The simulation runs in the browser, even in a match: the container serves the files, keeps the saves and passes messages between players, so it uses almost no CPU or memory. A WebGL-capable browser is required.

paths.name: Saves
paths.description: Where saved games, custom maps and player accounts are kept. Leave it on appdata: this folder holds the accounts and the key that signs their sign-ins, so losing it means everyone has to register again.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the game is reached on.
